g.title: Applications and scripts issue requests and subscribe to published state. Instrument policy and observing workflows live in these clients.
A subscriber to published state and events; host placement is not represented in this view.
A collection of device/controller daemons. The grouping does not imply a single process or a daemon-wide busy state.
